gazette_location.description_raw_en: An extension to the existing MA WANG ROAD which was gazetted on 29 September 1978 vide G.N. 2481 running in a west south-westerly direction for about 300 metres where it terminates at its junction with SHUI PIN WAI ROAD as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Drawing No. LD/YL/R5.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此路為一九七八年九月二十九日憲示第二四八一號所公告之媽橫路之延展部份，向西南偏西伸展約三百米，至與水邊圍路交界處終止。在LD/YL/R5號圖則上以粉紅色間以黑斜綫標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Street extending as a continuation of SAU FU STREET which was gazetted on 2 December 1977 vide G.N. 2944; commencing from the Yuen Long Fire Station Building and running in a westerly direction for about 152 metres, it then turns smoothly to run in a north-westerly direction for about 46 metres and then runs in a northerly direction for about 73 metres where it terminates at its junction with YUEN LONG ON NING ROAD as shown coloured pink and cross-hatched black on Drawing No. LD/YL/R5.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街為一九七七年十二月二日憲示第二九四四號所公告之壽富街之延展部份，由元朗消防局大厦起，向西伸展約一百五十二米，再順轉向西北伸展約四十六米，然後向北伸展約七十三米，至與元朗安寧路交界處終止。在LD/YL/R5號圖則上以粉紅色間以交錯黑斜綫標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Street commencing at its junction with YUEN LONG TAI CHEUNG STREET and running in a south-easterly direction for about 52 metres, it then bends slightly to run in a southerly direction for about 11 metres where it temporarily terminates as shown coloured pink and cross-hatched black on Drawing No. LD/YL/R5.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街由與元朗泰祥街交界處起，向東南伸展約五十二米，再略彎向南約十一米處暫時終止。在LD/YL/R5號圖則上以粉紅色間以交錯黑斜綫標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Square commencing at its junction with SAI YU STREET and running in a westerly direction for about 15 metres spanning the car park area surrounded by existing buildings as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Drawing No. LD/YL/R5.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此坊由與西裕街交界處起，向西伸展約十五米，跨過現有建築物圍繞之停車場。在LD/YL/R5號圖則上以粉紅色間以黑斜綫標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Open space commencing at its junction with SAU FU STREET and running in a northerly direction for about 50 metres and then extends across the existing service area, it then continues to run in a northerly direction for about 17 metres and terminates at its junction with YUEN LONG ON NING ROAD as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Drawing No. LD/YL/R5.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此坊由與壽富街交界處起，向北伸展約五十米，跨過現有之公共設施用地，繼續向北伸展約十七米，至與元朗安寧路交界處終止。在LD/YL/R5號圖則上以粉紅色間以黑斜綫標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Square abutting KIK YEUNG ROAD on the eastern side and surrounded by YLTL 145 and YLTL 87, ON SHUN STREET, YLTL 88 and YLTL 124 on the northern, western and southern sides respectively; it then continues to run in a southerly direction for about 34 metres and terminates at its junction with CASTLE PEAK ROAD YUEN LONG as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Drawing No. LD/YL/R5.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此坊東面與擊壤路毗鄰，其北、西及南面分別有元朗市地段第一四五及八十七號、安信街、元朗市地段第八十八號及第一二四號，向南伸展約三十四米，在與青山公路元朗段交界處終止。在LD/YL/R5號圖則上以粉紅色間以黑斜綫標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Square commencing at its junction with PO FAI PATH and extending in a westerly direction for about 65 metres and terminates at its junction with PING SHUN STREET as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Drawing No. LD/YL/R5.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此坊由與保輝徑交界處起，向西伸展約六十五米，至與屏信街交界處終止。在LD/YL/R5號圖則上以粉紅色間以黑斜綫標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Open space commencing at its junction with YUEN LONG HONG LOK ROAD and running in a westerly direction for about 45 metres and then extends across the service area; it then continues to run in a southerly direction for about 18 metres and terminates at its junction with KAU YUK ROAD as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Drawing No. LD/YL/R5.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此坊由與元朗康樂路交界處起，向西伸展約四十五米，跨過公共設施用地，再向南伸展約十八米，至與教育路交界處終止。在LD/YL/R5號圖則上以粉紅色間以黑斜綫標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Open space commencing at its junction with TAI TONG ROAD and running in a westerly direction for about 40 metres spanning the public light bus terminal surrounded by YLTL 302, HONG KING STREET, YLTL 268 and YLTL 270, and the proposed cooked food stalls on its northern, western, southern and eastern sides respectively as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Drawing No. LD/YL/R5.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此坊由與大棠路交界處起，向西伸展約四十米，然後跨過公共小型巴士總站，其北、西、南及東面分別有元朗市地段第三〇二號、康景街、元朗市地段第二六八號及第二七〇號，及建議中之熟食檔攤。在LD/YL/R5號圖則上以粉紅色間以黑斜綫標明。
